we have developed a new route to a new range of high free volume polyimides with intrinsic microporosity.
the combination of the intrinsic microporosity of the polymer with the high thermal and mechanical stability of the polyimide backbone results in high performance membranes.

we can design polyimide membranes with high gas permeability and high selectivity, and that these properties can be tuned by changing the polymer structure.
